subject: Shared delivery playlist: proposed milestones, owners, and runway
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Li <anna@helixai.com>, Helix AI Procurement <procurement@helixai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Shared delivery playlist: proposed milestones, owners, and runway

Hi Anna / Helix team —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a concise "shared delivery playlist" (attached) that maps milestone windows, owner handoffs, and the light-weight acceptance criteria we’ll use for go/no-go decisions. This is intended to be the working MAP for the next 8 weeks and will evolve, but I wanted to get a clear starting point so teams can book time.

Top-level milestones (proposed):
- Week 1–2: Environment provision + initial model access (Owner: Redwood infra — Karthik)
- Week 3: Integration sprint (API and auth) + E2E smoke tests (Owner: Helix Eng)
- Week 4: Data & prompts sync; baseline evals (Owners: Helix PM + Redwood ML)
- Week 5: Role-based cutover testing + latency tuning (Owners: Redwood SRE + Helix Eng)
- Week 6–8: Pilot run + acceptance sign-off (Owners: Helix Customer Ops + Redwood CS)

Ask: Can you confirm Helix owners for the Integration sprint and Pilot sign-off (I listed Anna and procurement as points of contact)? If dates are tight we can compress the timeline but need to understand any blackout windows on your side.

Attachments included: Shared_Delivery_Playlist_v1.xlsx (timeline + owners) and SOW_draft_v0.9.pdf (for procurement).

Next steps I propose:
1) Helix confirms owners and any date constraints by EOD Thursday.
2) We lock Week 1 provisioning window and schedule a joint API test on Day 10 after initial access.
3) Redwood will open a shared tracking board and invite the Helix squad.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into motion.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Principal Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172

From: Anna Li <anna@helixai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Helix AI Procurement <procurement@helixai.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared delivery playlist: proposed milestones, owners, and runway

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the clear plan and the spreadsheet — very helpful. A few quick notes from our side:

1) Owners:
- Integration sprint: I’ll own coordination but primary eng lead will be Miguel Soto (miguel.soto@helixai.com).
- Pilot sign-off: that will be under our Customer Ops lead, Priya Raman (cc'd to procurement for contract alignment).

2) Dates: We have a product release on Week 4 that creates a partial blackout for infra changes during Fri of Week 3 and Mon–Tue of Week 4. Can we move the Integration sprint start up by three days to compensate so smoke testing falls before that freeze?

3) Compliance & procurement: Procurement flagged that the SOW needs a clearer data-retention clause and confirmation of where logs will be stored for audits (SOC2 evidence requested). I’ve attached a short checklist (inline below).

Inline Procurement checklist (Helix):
- Data retention policy: please confirm default retention and options.
- Audit logs: location and access window for Helix auditors.
- SOW: need a line on sub-processor disclosure and encryption-at-rest.

If you can update the playlist and the SOW to reflect the blackout adjustment and procurement asks, we can get Miguel and Priya to review tomorrow.

Thanks,
Anna
Head of Product Integrations
Helix AI
anna@helixai.com

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Shared delivery playlist: proposed milestones, owners, and runway

Anna — great, thanks for the fast turnaround and for flagging the blackout. I updated the attached playlist and SOW to:
- Shift Integration sprint start earlier by 3 days so smoke tests complete before your Week 4 code freeze.
- Add a short data-retention bullet (default 90 days token-level logs; options for longer retention under enterprise add-on).
- Note that logs for audit will be stored in the customer project in our secure logging bucket (read-only access for Helix auditors; export on request).
- Added a sub-processor disclosure paragraph and an encryption-at-rest statement in SOW_draft_v0.9.pdf.

Quick callouts on ownership:
- Provisioning (Week 1–2): Karthik to lead Redwood infra; we’ll need Helix cloud admin to approve VPC peering and service account (Anna, please loop Miguel).
- Integration sprint (new dates): Helix Eng (Miguel) + Redwood Eng (Marissa) pairing sessions; propose three 90-minute pairing blocks on Day 2–4 of the sprint.
- Pilot acceptance: Helix Customer Ops (Priya) will execute sign-off checklist; Redwood CS (Naomi/Marissa) will validate SLA telemetry and acceptance gates.

Risk notes (high level):
- Procurement ACLs: if procurement requires a bespoke retention policy, we may need an SOW addendum which could push Pilot by 1–2 weeks.
- Infra blackouts increase risk to integration timing — recommend the earlier start as discussed.

Please see attachments (updated playlist + SOW) and confirm owners by EOD so we can lock calendars. If helpful I can schedule a 30-minute alignment with Miguel + Karthik this afternoon.

Thanks,
Naomi
Principal Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments referenced: Shared_Delivery_Playlist_v1.xlsx (updated), SOW_draft_v0.9.pdf (updated)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Shared delivery playlist: proposed milestones, owners, and runway

Looping in quickly from the eng side — we can absorb the 3-day shift and do the pairing sessions as Naomi suggested. A few internal items I’ll action this afternoon:
- Provisioning runbook: I’ll publish the step list and assign Karthik and one infra engineer (Raj Patel) to the ticket.
- Test harness: Redwood will provide a simple postman collection and a smoke-test script for Miguel to run during pairing; I’ll attach to the tracking board.
- Telemetry gate: I’ll add required metrics for pilot acceptance (95th p95 latency under 450ms, error rate <0.5% during 30-min window).

Risks / ask to Naomi: Please confirm whether Helix auditors need direct read-only access to the logging bucket or if exports are sufficient — procurement's preference will determine if we require the addendum.

I’ll join the alignment call if scheduled.

Marissa Cole
Senior Software Engineer, Integrations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
